meta_description:
12K likes, 518 comments - rhea_chakraborty on October 7, 2026: "This one happened because of you guys. 🩷

For months, every time I wore “that blush”, my comments and DMs were filled with the same question. “What blush are you wearing?”

The funny thing is, I never really had an answer.

So after enough of you asked, I thought… maybe I should actually do something about it. 🥹

I called @ghazalalagh and @saahilnayar @staze9to9 with one request. Can we make my exact blush? Not something similar. That one.

And they just got it.

They cared about every little detail, from the shade to the way it feels on the skin, and somehow turned something I loved into something I can finally share with all of you.

Ghazal and Saahil, thank you for believing in this little idea and putting so much love into bringing it to life. 🤍

So I can finally answer the question…

This is the blush. 🥹🩷

Caught Blushin’
Rhea x Staze

Made because you asked.
Made with a lot of love.

And finally, no more gatekeeping. 🫶🏼".
